narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think the total is nine, because four and three and two make nine.
<bookmark mark='ride'/>But minus three and minus two are presses that go down, not up.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The lift climbs four floors and then comes down five floors, so it ends below its start.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says the total is nine; the lift goes up 4 floors, then down 3 floors, then down 2 more and ends below where it began; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, start on any floor and ride the presses one by one.
<bookmark mark='same'/>Then start there again and press only the single button. Both rides must end on the same floor.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: start at any floor, press the set one by one, then press the single button, and both rides end on the same floor

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says the total is nine, because four and three and two make nine. Minus presses go down, so the total cannot be nine, and the bubble is struck.
